{{Quote|This, Grand Admiral Thrawn, is power. This city&mdash;this planet&mdash;these people. Every human, Psadan, and Myneyrsh who live here are mine. ''Mine''.|Joruus C'baoth, to Thrawn|<ref name="HTTE">''[[Heir to the Empire]]''</ref>}}
A '''kingdom''' led by a [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Joruus C'baoth]]<ref name="TEGtC" /> maintained a [[Monarchy/Legends|monarchy]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Wayland/Legends|Wayland]].<ref name="HTTES" /> 

{{Stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The ''[[Heir to the Empire Sourcebook]]'' and ''[[The Thrawn Trilogy Sourcebook]]'' treat the [[Guardian of Mount Tantiss]] and [[Joruus C'baoth]] as the same character.<ref name="HTTES" /><ref name="TTTS">''[[The Thrawn Trilogy Sourcebook]]''</ref> While [[1995]]'s ''[[The Essential Guide to Characters]]'' tries to clarify that Joruus C'baoth created the kingdom, it still mentions that he protected and guarded Mount Tantiss over many years.<ref name="TEGtC" />
